method: Real World with native ground, Atlas, trail, household/regional life and rival installs; real Adventure3DRenderer with a minimal software raster callback. Save state is warmed through native reads before taking exact before/after snapshots. Geometry is inspected rather than rasterized.
limits: All-scene availability snapshot uses chapter24, original flags unset, arrival positions and all runtime services installed. Supplemental state cases use the actual public native action functions.
This verifies representation coverage, finite combined meshes and save immutability; it does not measure art quality, phone GPU performance, browser bounds or every authored dialogue branch.
Illustrated sprite decoding/rasterization is omitted. The actual sprite ownership paths are checked by native classification and by separate focused tests.
